query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM inventory
WHERE branchId IS NULL
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;
